description: Decode a JSON Web Token WITHOUT verifying its signature — header, payload, expiry — and flag what makes it dangerous to accept (RFC 8725bis / RFC 9068): alg "none", no exp, exp that is not a NumericDate, alg differing only in letter case, a kid with path traversal or injection characters, a key or key URL carried in the header (jwk/jku/x5u), an access token without typ at+jwt, illegal characters. Give `expectedAlgorithm` (what your verifier uses) and, optionally, `key` to also catch algorithm confusion (HMAC verified with a public key) and HMAC secrets shorter than the hash. The key is only inspected locally, never sent anywhere.

expectedAlgorithm.description: The alg your verifier expects, e.g. RS256

key.description: The secret or public key your verifier uses (PEM, JWK or HMAC secret)

keyEncoding.description: How an HMAC secret is encoded

name: jwt_decode
